nodes.text: [i]The room is one enormous open book, its pages stacked like stairs. At the far end a small boy sits with his hands pressed over his eyes.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Spoiler
nodes.text: The dragon wins. The kingdom burns. Everyone you love is gone by chapter nine.

nodes.speaker: Pip
nodes.text: I didn't want to know! I just wanted to see if it was okay!

nodes.speaker: The Spoiler
nodes.text: It is not okay. I have read the end. I read it for you.
[i]Its words are enormous and they are not lying: when it says the floor will fall, the floor falls. But they are written in ink, and ink can be rewritten.[/i]
[i]Strike the book while it is reading, and what it reads is rewritten.[/i]
